purpose: Teach: 給油/特許庁/細分/折り返し/見込ん/配合/多角/個展

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究費、本気で、無駄な、給油代、絶対、節約しろ、絶対、頼んだぞ、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: Ren — don't waste the research fund. Cut costs on supplies, absolutely. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Sharp attack on the name. Steady pace with emphasis on financial discipline. The weight of expectation clear but not unkind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究成果、特許庁、本気で、登録、検討しております、絶対、社会の役に、立ちたいです、本気。
lines.en: Yes. We're seriously considering registering our research results with the patent office. I really want to make something that helps society.
lines.style: Earnest and slightly formal, with genuine hunger underneath. Careful enunciation. Leans forward slightly as though offering proof of worthiness. Slight tremor of real stakes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究テーマ、細分化して、明確化、本気で、進めろ、絶対、論文の質、上がるからな、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Break down your research theme into smaller pieces. Make it sharper. That's the key — it'll strengthen your papers.
lines.style: Instructional but warm. Speaks as though sharing a secret that matters. Moderate pace, deliberate. The confidence of someone who has seen this work before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先生からの折り返しのメール、本気で、待っております、絶対、楽しみに、しております、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. I'm really looking forward to your email back, Professor. I'm excited to hear what you think.
lines.style: Respectful, almost deferential. Quiet eagerness held in check. Slight pause before 'excited' — testing the vulnerability. Hopeful but careful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、君を、本気で、見込んでいるぞ、絶対、君の研究、社会、変えていける、絶対、本気で、頼んだぞ。
lines.en: Ren, I see real potential in you. Your research could change things. I mean that. Don't let me down.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Leans in on 'potential' — this is not casual observation. Steady eye contact in the voice. Final phrase drops slight — personal, not just professional.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験の配合比率、本気で、最適化、進めてまいります、絶対、本当に、頑張ります、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I'm going to work on optimizing the experimental ratios and keep moving forward. I'll really give it everything.
lines.style: Determined, almost fierce in its gentleness. Picks up pace slightly — momentum building. Finishes on a note of commitment, not question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究、多角的に、視野を、本気で、広げろ、絶対、君の論文、奥深くなる、絶対、本気で、頼んだぞ。
lines.en: Research is about seeing from many angles. Broaden your perspective. That's what will give your papers real depth.
lines.style: Patient educator. Almost conversational — speaking to someone capable of understanding. Measured pace. Lands on 'depth' with quiet finality, like settling something important.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先輩の個展、研究室、皆で、本気で、応援に、行きたいです、絶対、本気で、楽しみです、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. My senior's having an exhibition, and the whole lab wants to go support them. I'm really looking forward to it.
lines.style: Lighter, almost relieved after the intensity of the above. Genuine warmth. Small smile in the voice. Pace picks up slightly — this is something joyful, not fraught.
